title: On the pointwise convergence of NLS flow on $ §^2 $
summary: In this paper, we study the almost everywhere convergence of the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger flow to the initial data on $\mathbb S^2$, \begin{equation*} iu_t + Δ_g u = |u|^2u, \quad (t,x)\in\R\times §^2. \end{equation*} Inspired by the randomization method and the ansatz introduced by Burq, Camps, Sun, and Tzvetkov [Preprint, arXiv:2404.18229], we prove almost sure pointwise convergence almost everywhere for the nonlinear solution at very low regularity.
